items.text: Bank of America CEO Brian Moynihan says in wealth management AI helps relationship managers and advisors search and summarize information, preparing them to deliver personalized planning and personalized pitches to clients.
items.quote: In wealth management and our other relationship manager banking businesses, AI is helping those relationship managers and advisors search and summarize information, preparing them to deliver personalized planning and personalized pitches to clients for their business and help with their advice.

items.text: Bank of America CEO Brian Moynihan says its AI tools are designed to help customer relationship managers prepare more thoroughly for client meetings.
items.quote: These tools are designed to help our customer relationship managers prepare more thoroughly for the client meetings.

items.text: Bank of America CFO Alastair Borthwick says new AI-enabled tools help advisers prepare for client conversations, identify opportunities and deliver more personalized advice at scale.
items.quote: new AI-enabled tools that help advisers prepare for client conversations, identify opportunities and deliver more personalized advice at scale

items.text: Bank of America CEO Brian Moynihan says the firm's view of AI is enhanced intelligence, with teammates remaining critical to delivering services.
items.quote: Our view of AI is it's enhanced intelligence, that the teammates are going to be critical delivering the services

items.text: Edward Jones partnered with AI-driven third-party administrator Aboon to develop an end-to-end retirement plan management tool, which the firm hopes will help its advisors better serve business owners and their employees.
items.quote: The firm hopes the new technology will help its advisors better serve business owners and their employees.
